QuestInfo.name: [Labyrinth of Suffering] Toward the Crash Site
QuestInfo.0: It's a relief to finally meet up with another Alliance member. Maybe you'll find other Alliance soldiers soon.
QuestInfo.1:
If Azalin wasn't the one who screamed, then who did? It's probably best to get out of here for now and head back to the crash site.

(* Go to the left road in #b#m450011510##k.)
QuestInfo.2: This must be the right path, but the door you passed before is... gone? That can't be right. Doors don't just disappear, do they? And anyway, there's some kind of light shining through the crack in that wall...
